# roze.live — Robots.txt
# Stepan Roze — Front-End / JavaScript Developer portfolio

# A crawler obeys exactly ONE group: the most specific User-agent match.
# Groups are never merged. The previous file listed "User-agent: Googlebot /
# Allow: /" on its own, which meant Googlebot matched that group and ignored
# every Disallow below — and "Crawl-delay: 1" applied only to YandexBot,
# the last group in the file. One "*" group avoids both traps.

User-agent: *
Allow: /
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /private/
Crawl-delay: 1

# NOTE: a blanket "Disallow: /*.json$" used to live here. It blocked
# /manifest.json and /site.webmanifest, which Google needs for PWA and
# rich-result checks. The utm_* rules were also dropped — tracking params are
# handled by the self-referencing canonical, and blocking them stops Google
# from crawling shared campaign links at all.
#
# /#admin is a hash route. Fragments are never sent to the server, so robots.txt
# cannot block it; it is gated on the owner account inside the app instead.

Sitemap: https://roze.live/sitemap.xml
